style_excerpt: Cosy logistics colony sprite, mobile-readable, slightly top-down three-quarter view, hand-painted toy-like strategy-board aesthetic, clear silhouette, warm daylight from upper-left, no text, no UI, no border, single centered subject.

broad.base_prompt: Create a game sprite for a cosy logistics colony. {style_excerpt} Exploratory interpretation welcome. Subject: {subject}. Category: {category}. {category_hint}

production.base_prompt: Create a polished game sprite for a cosy logistics colony. {style_excerpt} Tight, consistent colony look. Subject: {subject}. Category: {category}. {category_hint}

category_hints.terrain: Tileable square terrain tile for a hex strategy map.
category_hints.buildings: Standalone building sprite with readable roof silhouette.
category_hints.logistics: Logistics unit or path element for a supply chain game.
category_hints.wares: Single resource item icon, iconic and simple.

negative_prompt_notes: text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, UI label, border frame, drop shadow plate, scenery backdrop, photorealistic, gritty realism, weapon, blood

variants.label: chunkier silhouette
variants.modifier: Use a chunkier, bolder silhouette with simplified shapes for small-screen readability.

variants.label: cleaner/simple version
variants.modifier: Use a cleaner, simpler design with fewer details and smooth painted shapes.

variants.label: more textured version
variants.modifier: Add gentle hand-painted surface texture while keeping the silhouette clear.

variants.label: warmer palette
variants.modifier: Use a warmer, sunlit colour palette with inviting earth tones.

variants.label: higher contrast mobile-readable
variants.modifier: Increase contrast and value separation for mobile readability.

variants.label: softer toy-like version
variants.modifier: Use softer, rounder toy-like forms with a friendly painted finish.
